result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so the zip entries are named from the configured aspect names. I haven't tested it. The `reports` module compiles, but I didn't run any tests or a renamed-aspect export.

Before, the code read and named the five scope files using fixed literals like `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. Renaming an aspect made that read throw, which skipped both `all_files.zip` and `git-history.zip`.

Now it takes the five scope aspects in the same order as before: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. For each one it works out the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the helper that writes the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files. It reads that file from the text folder and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because the failing read no longer happens, `git-history.zip` is written again when a `git-history.txt` exists.
